items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: then he went with Billy Leadman and Mary Stafford, they had a regular crew. And Grace Jackson.

ctx.x: I always remember that Frankie Jackson was nice. He was from Chicago. He was a nice guy. And another guy from Chicago, Billy Leadman. He was very good. And then they had a woman there. Nobody's ever danced like she, since. Was Grace Jackson. Grace Jackson was a terrific dancer, but she got up with one of those pimps around there and he got her on dope, see?
